description: Deterministic offline evaluation benchmark for Hebrew and English food retrieval against the bundled USDA FoodData Central reference catalog (13,225 foods). Measures retrieval hit rate, top-1 accuracy, missing-match rate, wrong-match rate, and negative-control abstention safety.
scope_note: Offline reference retrieval and Hebrew/English query normalization only. Does NOT measure multimodal photo recognition or portion estimation accuracy.
reference_source: USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy, Foundation Foods, FNDDS 2021-2023)
